title: Most goals at one Euros
brief: Name the ten players who scored the most goals at a single European Championship since Euro 96. Each player counts once, for his best tournament.
period: Euro 96 to Euro 2024, one tournament each (Euro 2020 was played in 2021)

notes.Michel Platini: Michel Platini scored 9 at Euro 84, before 1996.
notes.Marco van Basten: Marco van Basten scored 5 at Euro 88, before 1996.
notes.Ruud van Nistelrooy: Ruud van Nistelrooy scored 4 at Euro 2004.

sources: https://compstats.uefa.com/v1/player-ranking?competitionId=3&phase=TOURNAMENT&stats=matches_appearance,goals&seasonYear=<year> (UEFA's own player stats, one call per tournament 1996 to 2024)
checks: Goals per player per tournament from UEFA match goalscorers.csv for every tournament 1996 to 2024. Griezmann 6 in 2016; 5 each: Shearer 1996, Kluivert and Milosevic 2000, Baros 2004, Ronaldo and Schick 2020. The 4-goal pool: Harry Kane (2020), Nuno Gomes (2000), Romelu Lukaku (2020), Wayne Rooney (2004), Karim Benzema (2020), Ruud van Nistelrooy (2004), Emil Forsberg (2020), David Villa (2008). No one scored more than 3 at Euro 2024.
